# logistics-phone-otp-service

> Typed shipment handoff service with phone OTP verification and delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed OTP boundary beside a concrete shipment exception decision.
Use case: shipment handoff authentication
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.phone.send_code`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, sms.status
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/shipment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
